title: RetrievedLessons
description: Retriever output. Model gemini-3.5-flash, thinking low, over a tag-based BM25 pass on knowledge_base.json. Returns the top-K (default 5) lessons relevant to the plan, only those at or above relevance 0.5. The implementer prompt injects this list verbatim. Documented in shared/schemas/README.md. No em dashes in any string value.

id.description: Id of the source lesson in knowledge_base.json.

relevance_score.description: Relevance to this plan. Only lessons at or above 0.5 are returned.

retrieved_lessons.lesson_text: Primary action must sit in the bottom third for thumb reach. Top-right buttons fail on tall layouts.
